findings.title_text: s.40A(2)(b) reasonableness of the amount(s) paid to related person (tag 5d3a630f) is not assessed here
limits_text: s.40A(2)(b) disallows only the excess over fair market value / legitimate business need, which needs a comparable arm's-length rate or amount that the books do not carry; this test reports the amount actually moved, never a view on whether it is excessive.
ask_client_text: Confirm the basis (market rate, comparable, or documented business need) for the amount paid to this related person in each nature shown above.
